target_customer: Developers and teams deploying managed AI agents; originally developers running Claude Code who wanted remote control from phone and web
problem: Teams want managed agent speed without lock-in to one model, machine or cloud; originally, coding sessions needed to be monitored and steered away from the desk.
business_model: Open source core with a managed cloud and startup credits program
product_category: AI agent infrastructure (open source control plane)

founders.name: Ishaan Sehgal
prior_employers: Microsoft (AI infra engineer, built and led Kaito)

founders.name: Kartik Sarangmath
education: BS and MS in CS, Georgia Tech
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: three published papers.

technical_complexity.rationale: Syncing agent sessions across terminal, web and mobile, and later running agent execution and state as an API, is solid infrastructure work without research risk.

defensibility.rationale: Open source and easily cloned; many alternatives appear on directories and the model vendors ship their own managed agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The current site positions Omnara as the alternative to Claude Managed Agents, so the model vendor shipped a competing managed offering.

market_need_then: Claude Code adoption in mid 2025 created demand for remote monitoring and control of long-running agents.

identity.logo: Logo files on Brandfetch, design not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Developer, anti lock-in; 'We handle the infrastructure. You build the agent.'

branding.community_and_virality: Open source project with Apache 2.0 license; appears in several alternatives directories.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct name with a US trademark filed January 2026 (first use July 2025 per a trademark listing), but no press or community evidence about the brand itself was found.

pivots.from: Remote control of Claude Code sessions across terminal, web and mobile
pivots.to: Open source managed agent platform and control plane
pivots.why: Not stated; a company post dated January 28, 2026 labels the remote coding product as historical, per a secondary summary.

outcome_analysis: Omnara started as a Claude Code companion app in mid 2025 and moved to open source agent infrastructure by early 2026, competing directly with a model vendor's managed agents. No sourced funding beyond aggregator claims, no exit and no shutdown were found. The risk is vendor competition and a thin moat, offset by experienced infrastructure founders.
notes: Funding unverified: StartupIntros lists 500K seed (2025-09-01) with a long investor list including large funds, VCBacked calls it pre-seed with Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund; both aggregators, so no round is recorded. The investor list could not be confirmed against a primary source. Alternatives directories (Happy Coder and others) are undated, so competition is left empty. Pivot date comes from a secondary summary (RuntimeWire) of a company post that was not opened. Update: the $500K round dated 2025-09 is now recorded (StartupIntros says seed, VCBacked says pre-seed with YC and Pioneer Fund). It rests on aggregators, investors are left null because the lists conflict.
